core_obligations: Choose a surjective etale U -> X with U a scheme and set V = Z x_X U, so that i' : V -> U is a closed immersion of schemes (proof lines 2581-2583).
Use the base change formula for the small pushforward to identify (i_{small}^{-1}i_{small,*}G)|_V with the scheme expression (i')_{small}^{-1}i'_{small,*}(G|_V) (proof lines 2584-2590).
Apply the scheme case to conclude that the adjunction map is an isomorphism after restriction to V, hence globally, and deduce full faithfulness of i_{small,*} (proof lines 2591-2599).

For the essential image, take a sheaf F restricting to the point sheaf off Z and show that the adjunction map F -> i_{small,*}i_{small}^{-1}F is an isomorphism after restriction to U, hence an isomorphism (proof lines 2600-2612).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma on the small pushforward i_{small,*} along a closed immersion i : Z -> X of algebraic spaces over S: on sheaves of sets it is fully faithful with essential image the sheaves restricting to the point sheaf off Z, on abelian sheaves it is fully faithful with essential image the sheaves supported on |Z|, and in both cases i_{small}^{-1} is a left inverse (source lines 2551-2578). The proof descends the scheme case: for a surjective etale U -> X with U a scheme the base change i' : V = Z x_X U -> U is a closed immersion of schemes, the base change formula identifies (i_{small}^{-1}i_{small,*}G)|_V with the corresponding scheme expression, and etale descent plus the criterion for full faithfulness on the site gives the two functoriality statements and the description of the essential image.
